name: Raiden Kaname
source:
[i]"I’ve never seen a human with red blood. At least... not outside of old legends."[/i]

Someone who's accompanying you during your stay in the village. She appears masculine, and the sword techniques she unleashes are powerful enough to make one tremble. Despite her appearance being intimidating at first glance, beneath she's friendly and considerate towards everyone—yet there is something uncanny about her as she leaves no openings.

[Translated from [url=https://hyakunie.com/character/raiden-kaname/]official website[/url]]
